submission.justification: Selection-S2 (gradient-boosted classifier) gives the highest expected significance in the Monte Carlo scan: 4.17 sigma at 50% signal efficiency, versus a best of 3.36 sigma for S1 and 2.62 sigma for S3. The S2 curve peaks near 50% (45%: 3.99, 50%: 4.17, 55%: 4.08), so 50% is the working point. This matches the 2025 summary (S2 4.1 sigma at 50%). The 50% working point lies inside the 20-80% window. Caveat: the simulation covers statistical uncertainty only. S2 uses jet substructure, which can be harder to model, so background robustness against systematics has not been verified. Before unblinding, the background estimate for S2 should be checked for systematic robustness (for example, data-driven control regions or comparison against S1 as a cross-check). If that check fails, S1 at 35-65% (about 3.3-3.4 sigma) is the fallback.
